nodes.description: Ownable storage variable holding the contract owner address.
Wallet owner address stored in BaseWallet storage.
mapping(address => bool) tracking authorised modules of a wallet.
Controller contract reference used for module registry and factory checks.
mapping(bytes4 => address) binding function selectors to modules for the fallback dispatch.
Reentrancy lock flag used by the nonReentrant modifier.
mapping(address => Wallet) holding guardians, inheritor and lock state per wallet.
mapping(address => Quota) daily spending quota data per wallet.
mapping(address => mapping(bytes32 => bool)) consumed signed-request hashes.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) whitelist effective timestamps.
Address nominated to become the owner pending claim.
Mutable PriceOracle reference used for token value conversions.
Array of module addresses the upgrader will add to the wallet.
Array of module addresses the upgrader will remove from the wallet.
Caller-controlled address used throughout for authorisation and module identity.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for guardian, quota and whitelist timing logic.
Transfers contract ownership to a new address, restricted to onlyOwner.
Sets the owner to address(0), restricted to onlyOwner.
Initialises the wallet owner once, callable only from the factory.
Initialises controller and initial module set for a new wallet.
Changes the wallet owner, callable only from a registered module.
Replaces the controller reference, callable only from a registered module.
Adds and activates a module, callable from factory or module.
Deactivates and removes a module, callable only from a module.
View helper returning whether an address is a registered module.
Binds a function selector to a module for fallback dispatch.
Executes a call/delegatecall/staticcall on behalf of the wallet.
Dispatches arbitrary calldata to the module bound to msg.sig.
Internal module registration that activates the module on the wallet.
Private low-level call dispatcher implementing modes CALL, DELEGATECALL and STATICCALL.
Binds the module methods to the calling wallet.
Unbinds the module methods from the calling wallet.
Access check asserting msg.sender is a module of the given wallet.
Schedules a new daily quota for a wallet, module gated.
Validates available quota against a price oracle and records spending.
Records spending against a wallet quota, module gated.
Adds or schedules a guardian for a wallet using block.timestamp validation.
Removes or schedules removal of a guardian using block.timestamp validation.
Cancels pending guardian additions/removals and re-checks module authorisation.
Compacts the guardian array by deleting removed guardians.
Deletes all guardians of a wallet; authorises only when the list is non-empty.
View helper testing guardian status including pending additions.
Marks a signed-request hash as consumed after module authorisation.
Whitelists an address for a wallet with a timestamp-based effective time.
Removes an address from a wallet whitelist.
View helper evaluating whitelist effectiveness against block.timestamp.
Overridden ownership transfer that only nominates a pendingOwner.
Finalises ownership transfer by the pendingOwner.
Upgrades the proxy implementation, restricted to the proxy owner.
Upgrades the implementation then performs an arbitrary call on the proxy.
Transfers proxy ownership, restricted to the proxy owner.
Refreshes lastActive with block.timestamp when inheritance conditions hold.
Sets wallet inheritor, waiting period and lastActive timestamp.
Sets the locked flag of a wallet, module gated.
Self-invoked upgrade routine that mutates the wallet controller and module set.
Copies guardians and inheritor from the old SecurityStore to the new one.
Computes gas cost, updates quota spending and transfers gas token to the recipient.
Wrapper performing a CALL transaction through the wallet.
Performs ERC20/ETH transfers through the wallet and validates return data.
Iterates bindable methods and binds them to the wallet.
Performs a staticcall to a signer contract to validate an ERC1271 signature.
Adds a manager to the manager address set, owner gated.
Removes a manager from the manager address set, owner gated.
Low-level target.call{value: value}(data) enabling arbitrary external execution and reentrancy.
Low-level target.delegatecall(data) executing untrusted code in wallet storage context.
Low-level target.staticcall(data) performing an external read-only call.
module.call{value: msg.value}(msg.data) inside the fallback, forwarding arbitrary calldata.
Inline assembly returndatacopy/revert bubbling up failure data in transact.
address(this).call{value: msg.value}(data) performing an arbitrary self call after upgrade.
signer.staticcall(callData) to an untrusted contract when verifying ERC1271 signatures.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender equality with owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership on msg.sender.
onlyFromFactory checks msg.sender against controller.walletFactory().
onlyFromModule checks modules[msg.sender] before changing the owner.
onlyFromModule gates controller replacement through msg.sender.
onlyFromFactoryOrModule authorises addModule using msg.sender.
onlyFromModule gates removeModule using msg.sender.
onlyFromModule gates bindMethod using msg.sender.
onlyFromFactoryOrModule authorises transact using msg.sender.
fallback uses msg.sig and module lookup, and forwards msg.value from the caller.
requireWalletModule validates msg.sender via Wallet(wallet).hasModule.
onlyWalletModule validates msg.sender before guardian state changes.
onlyWalletModule validates msg.sender before guardian removal.
onlyWalletModule validates msg.sender before whitelist updates.
onlyOwner gates Claimable.transferOwnership on msg.sender.
onlyPendingOwner compares msg.sender with pendingOwner.
onlyProxyOwner gates proxy ownership transfer on msg.sender.
UpgraderModule.activate treats msg.sender as the wallet being upgraded.
onlyOwner gates addManager on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates removeManager on msg.sender.
changeQuota resolves the current quota through block.timestamp comparison.
checkAndAddToSpent computes spent quota using block.timestamp.
addGuardian requires validSince >= block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
removeGuardian requires validUntil >= block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
isGuardian activity depends on guardian timestamps compared to block.timestamp.
addToWhitelist clamps effectiveTime against block.timestamp.
isWhitelisted compares effectiveTime with block.timestamp.
touchLastActiveWhenRequired branches on block.timestamp versus lastActive plus interval.
setInheritor stores block.timestamp into lastActive.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into the owner state variable.
renounceOwnership sets owner to address(0).
Claimable.transferOwnership stores the nominee in pendingOwner.
claimOwnership assigns pendingOwner to owner.
claimOwnership clears pendingOwner after claiming.
initOwner writes _initialOwner into _owner storage.
setOwner writes newOwner into _owner storage.
setController replaces the controller state reference.
init stores the provided controller instance.
init loops over _modules and calls the internal _addModule helper.
addModule delegates registration to _addModule.
removeModule externally invokes Module(_module).deactivate on an untrusted module.
_addModule sets modules[_module] to true.
_addModule externally calls Module(_module).activate, enabling re-entry into the wallet.
hasModule reads the modules mapping.
bindMethod writes the selector binding into methodToModule.
transact routes execution through the private _call dispatcher.
fallback looks up the destination module in methodToModule using msg.sig.
fallback forwards msg.data and msg.value to the bound module with a raw call.
mode 1 executes an arbitrary value-bearing external call on the target.
mode 2 delegatecalls into an arbitrary target using wallet storage.
mode 3 performs a staticcall to an arbitrary target.
transact uses inline assembly to revert with the raw returndata on failure.
activate calls bindMethods for the logical sender wallet.
bindMethods calls back into the wallet contract via bindMethod.
requireWalletModule queries Wallet(wallet).hasModule(msg.sender).
changeQuota writes currentQuota, pendingQuota and pendingUntil into quotas.
checkAndAddToSpent reads and updates the wallet quota record.
addToSpent updates spentAmount and spentTimestamp in quotas.
addGuardian mutates the guardians array and index map in wallets.
removeGuardian mutates guardian status and timestamps in wallets.
cancelPendingGuardians rewrites guardian statuses and timestamps.
_cleanRemovedGuardians rearranges and pops entries of the guardian array.
removeAllGuardians deletes guardian mappings and the guardian array.
removeAllGuardians calls requireWalletModule before deleting all guardians.
isGuardian reads the guardian record for a wallet.
verifyAndUpdate marks hashes[wallet][hash] as consumed.
verifyAndUpdate authorises the caller through requireWalletModule.
addToWhitelist writes the effective time into effectiveTimeMap.
removeFromWhitelist deletes the effectiveTimeMap entry.
isWhitelisted reads effectiveTimeMap for the wallet and address.
upgradeToAndCall first calls upgradeTo with the new implementation.
upgradeToAndCall performs an arbitrary self call with caller-supplied data and value.
touchLastActiveWhenRequired authorises through requireWalletModule.
setInheritor writes inheritor, waiting period and lastActive.
setLock writes the locked flag of the wallet record.
UpgraderModule.activate may call w.setController on the wallet.
activate removes obsolete modules and finally removes itself.
activate adds the configured new modules to the wallet.
activate performs the legacy SecurityStore data migration.
migrateSecurityStore calls addGuardian on the new SecurityStore for each guardian.
migrateSecurityStore restores the inheritor via setInheritor.
reimburseGasFee records spending via quotaStore.checkAndAddToSpent.
reimburseGasFee transfers the gas token through transactTokenTransfer.
transactTokenTransfer builds calldata and calls transactCall.
transactCall invokes Wallet(wallet).transact, re-entering the wallet execution path.
verifyERC1271Signature performs a staticcall to the untrusted signer contract.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter flows into setOwner.
_initialOwner parameter flows into initOwner.
_controller parameter flows into init.
_modules parameter flows into init.
_module parameter flows into addModule.
_module parameter flows into removeModule.
_method selector flows into bindMethod.
mode parameter selects the execution path in transact.
to parameter becomes the call target of the low-level call.
value parameter is forwarded as ETH value in the low-level call.
data parameter is forwarded as calldata in the low-level call.
newOwner parameter is stored by Claimable.transferOwnership.
implementation parameter flows into upgradeTo.
data parameter is used as the payload of the self call in upgradeToAndCall.
newOwner parameter flows into transferProxyOwnership.
wallet parameter selects the storage slot mutated by addGuardian.
addr parameter is stored as a guardian by addGuardian.
validSince parameter is validated and downcast in addGuardian.
alwaysOverride parameter decides whether an existing guardian entry is overwritten.
wallet parameter selects the storage slot mutated by removeGuardian.
addr parameter identifies the guardian to remove.
validUntil parameter is validated and stored by removeGuardian.
_inheritWaitingPeriod parameter is written to the wallet record.
newQuota parameter is validated and stored by changeQuota.
effectiveTime parameter is downcast to pendingUntil by changeQuota.
amount parameter is priced and validated against the available quota.
hash parameter keys the hash consumption mapping in verifyAndUpdate.
effectiveTime parameter is clamped and stored by addToWhitelist.
wallet local variable carries msg.sender into the upgrade operations.
guardians local array is iterated during the SecurityStore migration.

newOwner is a parameter used only by BaseWallet.setOwner.
_initialOwner is a parameter used only by BaseWallet.initOwner.
_controller is a parameter used only by BaseWallet.init.
_modules is a parameter used only by BaseWallet.init.
_module is a parameter used only by BaseWallet.addModule.
_module is a parameter used only by BaseWallet.removeModule.
_method is a parameter used only by BaseWallet.bindMethod.
mode selects the execution path inside BaseWallet.transact.
to becomes the target address of the low-level call executed by _call.
value is forwarded as the ETH value of the low-level call.
data is forwarded as the calldata of the low-level call.
newOwner is a parameter used only by Claimable.transferOwnership.
implementation is a parameter used only by upgradeTo.
data is the self-call payload consumed by upgradeToAndCall.
newOwner is a parameter used only by transferProxyOwnership.
wallet selects the storage slot used by addGuardian.
addr is the guardian address stored by addGuardian.
validSince is validated and downcast inside addGuardian.
alwaysOverride modifies the control flow of addGuardian.
wallet selects the storage slot used by removeGuardian.
addr identifies the guardian removed by removeGuardian.
validUntil is validated and stored inside removeGuardian.
_inheritWaitingPeriod is stored by SecurityStore.setInheritor.
newQuota is validated and stored by QuotaStore.changeQuota.
effectiveTime becomes pendingUntil inside QuotaStore.changeQuota.
amount is priced and checked by QuotaStore.checkAndAddToSpent.
hash keys the consumed-hash mapping in HashStore.verifyAndUpdate.
effectiveTime is clamped and stored by WhitelistStore.addToWhitelist.
wallet local variable derived from msg.sender is consumed by UpgraderModule.activate.
guardians local array is consumed by UpgraderModule.migrateSecurityStore.
